# 跨國鎮壓 / Transnational Repression

**Tier E event record.** The community is a party to this: people of Taiwanese and Hong Kong
origin living in the United States, Canada and Europe are surveilled, coerced, or attacked on
behalf of the PRC state. This page is not commentary on the news — it is the archive's own
record of a pattern we have documented since 2021, assembled from our own holdings so that any
future story lands on a spine we already have.

## 從每日脈絡來的話

這頁不是今天的新聞。每日脈絡把你送到這裡，是因為今天的報導用了「跨國鎮壓」。點進來應看到兩件事：我們從 2021 年就有的紀錄，以及今天這幾則報導各自落在哪個已有的形狀上。下面每一則今天的消息都標 **報導**，不是我們核對過的檔案。

(2) 支應日常生活開銷 **86.5%** 感到寬裕或得以支應（2 年前 74.6%，歷年新高），仍有約 **10%** 因 K 型經濟認為有支應困難; (3) 緊急預備金：**51.6%** 有足以維持至少半年生活基本開銷的存款緩衝、**10.7%** 有 3 至 6 個月，即約三分之二有 3 個月以上緩衝; (4) the headline limb — 急需大額用錢時的籌錢管道，過去以「自己儲蓄、家庭及朋友」的人際安全網為主，本次**個人儲蓄及家庭友人籌資占比下降至 72%**，而**變賣股票和基金、保單借款、銀行貸款**分別較去年增加 **3.8%、5.2%、10.6%**，金研院因此建議個人儲蓄仍應至少保留**三個月以上**生活費用的現金、不宜過度依賴槓桿; (5) 理財建議來源轉移 — 理專等銀行管道從 2 年前的 **24% 降至 11%**，投顧老師從 **12.9% 增至 22.9%**，社群／網紅比率上升; (6) 防詐信心從 **65.7% 增至 73.8%**，連動 打詐儀表板 報案件數（2025 年 **19.7 萬**件、今年前 9 月 **11.9 萬**件，紙上轉述）; (7) 高齡與虛擬資產落差 — **70 歲以上**族群在電子支付與防詐信心上呈現高齡金融弱勢；政府今年 6 月底推動虛擬資產專法後，聽過加密貨幣者達 **7 成 6**、表示了解的只有 **2 成**，近 **7 成**不願持有虛擬資產; (8) 宏觀背景 — 2025 年家庭金融資產全數成長 **8.7%**、每戶可支配所得突破 **100 萬**（每人約 36 萬）、消費成長超過 5%，AI 與半導體需求帶動台股屢創新高; (9) the sibling limb — 9 月新開戶創新高（+6.5 萬人）、30 歲以下新開戶 **4.1 萬戶占 6 成 3**，大學生因 FOMO 進場並把定期定額視為儲蓄，金研院院長**高一誠**稱已與台大、政大、輔大、中原、中山、中正、逢甲、成大、東華等近十家大專院校合作開設每學期 1 學分的股匯投資金融教育課程，並提及明年 **TISA** 政策與集保等公司合作設計教材. **Labeling:** 調查數字、信心度、占比增減 are the institute's survey results as carried by the papers — 報導, not verified by this archive against the institute's own report; Substance retained, all of it Webster's / the Atlantic Council's as reported: (1) the thesis — Beijing is laying the groundwork for an **energy quarantine** of Taiwan, and the risk could **peak in 2028–2029** on economic, political, technical and military grounds (both Taiwan and the US hold key elections in 2028; Taiwan's electricity reserve margin is on track to reach dangerously low levels in that period; US readiness may be degraded by protracted other-theater deployments; Xi's age and a possible US AI takeoff window); (2) the mechanism limb — a quarantine lets some ships through and turns back others, especially **oil tankers and LNG carriers**, allowing Beijing to claim a **domestic law-enforcement** measure rather than an act of war; the PRC coast guard's continuous presence east of Taiwan and its interdictions of live commercial traffic are read by the author as rehearsal; (3) the exposure limb — Taiwan has virtually no indigenous oil/gas/coal and is almost totally reliant on seaborne hydrocarbon imports; indigenous energy production (incl. nuclear) fell from **8.3% to 5.3%** of demand **2016→2025**; statutory reserve floors are oil **90 days** / coal **30** / LNG **11**, and the **MOEA reported on-hand inventories of 150 / 40 / 11 days in March 2026** (author's own figures, not re-derived here); (4) the timing limb — China's oil security (electrification of transport fuel, domestic crude, overland pipeline imports largely from Russia, refinery maximization, large petroleum stockpiles) lets it decouple from international markets and act more aggressively, while a quarantine would rely on supply flows rather than stock withdrawals; the US 「implicit answer」 — a counter-blockade of China's oil imports — is judged **increasingly outdated**; (5) the two scenarios — a direct coast-guard interdiction under a legal pretext, or an indirect route exploiting/stimulating a Middle East oil crisis that disproportionately hurts import-dependent rivals while China becomes a 「self-sufficient electrotech state」; (6) the recommendation limb — an all-of-the-above generation mix plus transmission hardening; **expand nuclear** and restart the **third plant at Maanshan in 2028** (reactors unlikely to be deliberately struck because Beijing does not want radiation on the island it seeks to seize); deepen ties with the **US LNG complex** and expand gas storage; and the headline plan — a **「north diesel, south renewables」** posture: northern Taiwan is a net importer of 「南電北送」 power, Taipei's solar capacity factor is 「about the same as Seattle's」, onshore land is minimal, offshore wind underperforms in peak summer months, and the **Datan and Tunghsiao** gas plants plus finite northern LNG mean **Taipei could run out of electricity in under one month** if south-to-north lines are cut; for **~US$10 billion capex + ~US$500 million/yr** to maintain, test and rotate fuel, the north could field **~2 GW of diesel generation** (author's own calculation) — about half the capex for a dedicated diesel stockpile and dispersed hardened storage, the rest for generators — enough to keep hospitals, cooling stations, sanitation, telecom and emergency services running in the north for **roughly five months** without southern power; a first tranche stood up by **summer 2027** with exercises during the **Urban Resilience** drills, full buildout across **2028–2029**; the south/center keep existing thermal plants plus onshore solar/wind that are hard to interdict; (7) the US-role limb — US firms to engage across the diesel/LNG/nuclear/solar-storage supply chain, and the chief US contribution judged to be **preventing sabotage** of south-to-north transmission and energy infrastructure, with the author asserting CCP intelligence services would use cyber and kinetic means including **connections with criminal networks**, so the US should rotate far more energy, counternarcotics and countersabotage personnel through Taiwan drawing on **DOE, DEA, FBI** and other civilian agencies **through AIT**; (8) the leverage limb — China's **food** vulnerability and its steel industry's dependence on **Australian iron ore**, plus economic/financial leverage, with the author's own figure that **net exports contributed 32.7% of China's GDP growth, the highest since 1997**; and (9) the policy-posture limb — Washington should underscore continued commitment to the 「One China」 policy **anchored to the Taiwan Relations Act, the three communiqués and the Six Assurances** while warning Beijing against aggression. **Labeling:** 「energy quarantine」「laying the groundwork」「dangerous new reality」「self-sufficient electrotech state」「increasingly outdated」 are the author's framings carried as reported; the 2028–2029 peak, the $10B/2 GW/5-month arithmetic and the sabotage read are **his estimates and his inferences, not findings of this archive** (his own 「based on author calculations」 hedge retained); (5) **學術 limb** — 「國立臺灣師範大學一篇碩士論文發現，『不會』與『不客氣』在台灣華語中各有適用對象，兩者並不能任意替換」; named as **師大華語文教學系研究生黃家安** in 指導教授 **洪嘉馡** 指導下, 論文《臺灣華語回應感謝之語用策略及教學建議》, **於2024年出版**, 方法 「自然對話、口語語料庫及問卷調查」, 歸納出 **四種策略與九種說法**（「不用客氣」、「不客氣」、「哪裡」、「不會」、「沒事」、「謝謝」、「嗯」、「好」, plus 什麼都不說也沒有肢體動作的「零形式」）; 發現 「不客氣」較適合**長輩對晚輩**、「帶有回絕對方客套態度的意味」，「不會」用在**平輩之間或晚輩回應長輩**、「間接化解對方的虧欠感」，「謝謝」適用於**雙方存在互惠關係**的情境; 論文並點出 **華語教材把回應感謝的方式過度簡化**、易讓學習者誤以為一說通用 — 「正好呼應外國網友『課本和現實不一樣』的經驗」.

passed 眾議院 and is now in **參議院二讀**; (2) sponsor **James Bezan 貝贊**（保守黨，影子國防部長，2025-09-16 提出）三讀辯論 2026-10-08: the bill renames 《腐敗外國官員受害者正義法》→《謝爾蓋·馬格尼茨基法》、《特別經濟措施法》→《全球制裁與特別經濟措施法》（第二號）, first defines 良心犯 and 跨國鎮壓 in Canadian law, requires 外交部長 annual 國會報告 on 人權捍衛者/良心犯 work, raises 規避制裁罰款上限 to $100,000, and sets a **24-month timetable** for confiscation of sanctioned persons' Canadian assets, proceeds distributable to victims or government; answering **Ziad Aboultaif 齊亞德·阿布勒泰夫**（保守黨）he said the 法輪功 group 「受到迫害和殺害，其器官被非法摘取並出售到世界各地」; answering **Mario Beaulieu 馬里奧·博利厄**（魁人政團）he cited evidence of 醫生 and others trading in victims' 心臟、肺、肝、腎（「一種令人作嘔的行為」）and criticized 中共對維吾爾人 實施「再教育」、絕育及強迫勞動; he calls the amended bill less comprehensive than the original but 「對於未來現代化加拿大制裁機制至關重要」, and urges an 國際反腐敗法院; (4) Bezan names 壹傳媒創辦人 **黎智英** as the typical 良心犯（「他是一名良心犯，我們必須營救他」，per Bezan 已判終身監禁）, and alleges 北京 has 警察站 in Canada and 至少干預過兩次選舉; (5) cross-party endorsements: 自由黨資深議員 **Judy Sgro 思格若**（10-20 對大紀元：「真正開始讓這些法律長出牙齒 put some teeth in these laws」）、外交部長國會祕書 **Mona Fortier 莫娜·福捷**（「提高透明度，並使加拿大的制裁制度現代化」；委員會修訂使年度人權報告不再公開列名個別良心犯以贯彻「不造成傷害」原則）、**Chi Nguyen 阮芝**（「加強加拿大的制裁制度，並更新人權框架」，選區居民關注海外親友所受政治鎮壓與任意拘留）、**Sameer Zuberi 薩米爾·祖貝里**（委員會曾聽取 藏人、維吾爾人、法輪功修煉者、香港人及受伊朗、俄羅斯鎮壓者證詞）、魁人政團 **博利厄**（支持擴大制裁、限制受制裁者家屬簽證、RCMP–FINTRAC 合作及資產沒收）. **Labeling:** 「跨國鎮壓」「良心犯」「活摘」「警察站」「干預兩次選舉」「再教育、絕育及強迫勞動」are Bezan's and the paper's framings carried as reported; — 大紀元記者戴德蔓 2026-10-13. Same event as the LTN wire above. The Canadian documentary《國有器官》,
which exposes PRC forced organ harvesting through testimony of practitioners and victims' families,
drew bomb, gunshot and cyber threats against multiple Taiwan cinemas and related organizations during
its run; on 10-08 陸委會 invited the production team — director **章勇進** (Raymond Zhang), producer
**宋美馨** (Cindy Song), 台灣法輪大法學會理事長 **蕭松山**, 新唐人記者 **張東旭** — with 法政處長 **周鳴瑞**
receiving, to 關心 the intimidation and interference they faced. 周鳴瑞 framed the pattern as
跨國鎮壓: threats against screening venues and interference with distribution are aimed not only at

gave up protesting, and were harassed anyway. Named first-person accounts: **徐其仁** (江西) supplied a call recording
in which local 國保 personnel, having taken his mother to a 中共社區機構 and phoning him in front of her, said they
knew of his CDPIA membership and his dealings with 界立建, demanded he withdraw, referenced his pregnant wife, warned
his mother could be implicated and that he faced imprisonment if he returned to China. **張劉敏** (河南鄭州) and
**方碩** (江蘇) each received threat calls before the Washington trip — 張劉敏 threatened with her child's safety —
both stood down, were harassed regardless, and were told to leave the alliance and cut contact with 界立建 or
「後果自負」; 張劉敏 said she would not withdraw and would publicize the case and pursue legal accountability.
界立建 said the harassment is not confined to families in China: the alliance's **Malaysia** web administrator
**楊佳** was followed and threatened and dare not return to his residence, and members in **Thailand** feared
rendition to China. Rally attendee **李中平** said Flushing was chosen precisely because it is 華人集中, and called
on the U.S. government to investigate CCP agents operating illegally in the U.S. and to protect threatened people.
界立建 said the alliance is collecting names, recordings and video to submit to the U.S. government, Congress and
international human-rights bodies under the Global Magnitsky Act, and urged targets to report and preserve evidence.

## Why this belongs in Echopedia

Per CONTROL §1b, the Tier D↔E discriminator is whether **the community is a party**, not
whether the story is famous. It is:

- The targets are members of, or adjacent to, the diaspora we record — 台灣人 abroad, 僑界,
  Hong Kong residents in U.S. cities, and family members of public figures.
- The operations occur on soil where our members live: Los Angeles, the San Gabriel Valley,
  Toronto, university towns across the U.S.
- Our archive carried the evidence **before** the current cycle made it a headline.

Labeling standard: every claim below carries its status. **Sourced** = a document in this
archive. **Reported** = press assertion we have not independently verified. **Alleged** =
accusation in a filing or statement, recorded with attribution and without a finding of fact.
Nothing is omitted for being uncomfortable; nothing is asserted beyond what the record holds.

## NEED YOU
